description: This AR-pattern assault rifle was made using a 3D printer, with no metal parts except the barrel and bolt, resulting in a very lightweight weapon.  It takes STANAG magazines.
This 3D-printed machine pistol is made without any metal parts except the barrel and slide internals.  As a result, it is very lightweight, if not very durable.  It takes Glock 17 magazines.

A custom 3D-printed pump-action repeating crossbow made out of carbon fiber and synthetic cord.  This expensive hunting weapon is surprisingly lightweight thanks to its construction, but only a 3D printer can repair it.
